keybindings.bindingsDesc: When a combo matches, invoke the target event (with optional payload). The event list comes live from loaded plugins — it grows/shrinks as plugins load/unload; events without descriptions show the raw channel name.
keybindings.noBindings: No bindings yet. Click “Add binding”, press a combo, then pick a target event from the list.
keybindings.channelMissing: target plugin not loaded — binding inactive
keybindings.recording: Press the combo you want to bind…
keybindings.recordingHint: {{mod}}/Ctrl/Alt combos or a bare key; Esc to cancel
keybindings.noEvents: No events available. Events come from channels declared by loaded plugins.
keybindings.whenSmart: Smart (bare keys don't fire while typing; combos do)
keybindings.whenAlways: Always (including while typing; may intercept input)
keybindings.payloadHint: Arguments sent to the event. Empty = no payload; selecting an event with an example pre-fills it.
